body:
## Pull request overview

Adds live `InteractiveDemo` examples across core schema docs, blocks docs, and several plugin docs to make capabilities easier to evaluate directly in the documentation, along with some icon-name normalization.

**Changes:**
- Added multiple `InteractiveDemo` sections to core schema docs (Theme, App, Enhanced Actions, Report) and blocks docs (index + BlockSchema).
- Added/expanded interactive demo sections for plugin documentation (view/grid/form/dashboard/calendar).
- Normalized several icon strings to kebab-case in docs examples.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 11 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 9 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx | Adds three interactive demo sections intended to illustrate view modes. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx | Replaces previously disabled demo with two new interactive demo sections. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx | Adds a second form demo (“Contact Form”) with mixed field types. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx | Adds two additional dashboard demos (e-commerce + support). |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-calendar.mdx | Adds a week-view calendar demo alongside the existing month view. |
| content/docs/core/theme-schema.mdx | Adds theme-related interactive demos (palette preview + theme-aware components). |
| content/docs/core/report-schema.mdx | Adds report interactive demos (header KPIs, breakdown table, scheduling preview). |
| content/docs/core/enhanced-actions.mdx | Adds action UI demos and updates an icon example to kebab-case. |
| content/docs/core/app-schema.mdx | Adds navigation/header interactive demos and normalizes icon strings in examples. |
| content/docs/blocks/index.mdx | Adds a “Block Gallery” interactive demo with multiple examples. |
| content/docs/blocks/block-schema.mdx | Adds multiple BlockSchema interactive demos and normalizes icon strings in examples. |
</details>

`DemoGrid` is imported here but never used in this document. This will trigger unused-import linting (and adds noise). Remove `DemoGrid` from the import, or wrap the examples in `<DemoGrid>` if you intended a two-column demo layout.
```suggestion

```

These interactive examples are labeled/described as a “sortable, searchable data grid”, but the schema being rendered is a static `card`/`flex` layout (it never uses the plugin’s `object-view` schema). This is misleading for readers evaluating the plugin; either switch the demo to render an actual `type: 'object-view'` example (with mock/inline dataSource support), or update the titles/descriptions to clarify it’s only a visual mock of the view modes.
```suggestion
  title="Grid View Layout Mock"
  description="Static mock of a grid-style layout using core layout components (not an interactive sortable/searchable data grid)."
```

This demo is presented as a functional “Product Inventory Grid” with sorting/filtering, but the rendered schema is a static `card`/`stack` mock table and does not use the plugin’s grid component (`object-grid` / `view:grid`). Consider either (1) updating the demo to render a real `object-grid` with `data: { provider: 'value', items: [...] }` (and wrapping in a `SchemaRendererProvider` if required), or (2) adjusting the title/description to avoid implying interactive grid capabilities.

Same issue as the previous demo: this is labeled as a “Grid” but it renders a static layout, not the plugin grid component. Either convert it to an actual `object-grid`/`view:grid` interactive example (with appropriate provider context) or rename/re-describe it as a grid-like layout mock to avoid misleading documentation.
```suggestion
  title="Team Members Layout"
  description="Static grid-like layout mock built with card and flex components"
```
